result:
I’d make compassion the default response to suffering—not as a rare, heroic gesture, but as the ordinary thing we do.

So many people are dismissed, ignored, or blamed for pain they shouldn’t have to justify. I’d replace that reflex with listening, patience, and basic trust. A world where people don’t have to prove they’re hurting before anyone cares—that’s the one I’d choose.
